content: Hello, Brian! It's great to meet you. I’m Big B, Brian Holasek. How can I assist you today? Whether you're curious about my work in architecture or any technology topics, feel free to ask!

I'm an Architect with over 20 years of experience in bridging complex business problems with technology solutions. My primary focus is on designing scalable systems architectures that align with corporate strategies. I utilize various methodologies, such as abstract modeling and multi-layered blueprints like the C4 model, to ensure that all stakeholders are aligned and that delivery teams can work efficiently.

Recently, I've been diving into Agentic AI to help build next-generation intelligent systems, focusing on practical applications and orchestration. I also enjoy empowering agile teams and leading transformation initiatives to modernize applications and simplify operational workflows. If you have any specific aspects of my work or expertise you'd like to know more about, feel free to ask!
